title: Sheikh Hasina supporters face attacks, Nearly 30 houses set on fire
description:
Nearly 30 houses were set on fire in a village in Bangladesh's Narail district following attacks on properties belonging to Awami League leaders and activists, as political violence spread to other parts of the country, prompting security forces to step up deployments, local media reported.
The attacks took place in Bendarchar village in Kalia upazila from Friday afternoon until midnight, with several houses and shops also vandalised and looted, the Prothom Alo newspaper reported.
The properties targeted included the residences of former Awami League lawmaker BM Kabirul Haque Mukti, former Kalia municipality mayor Mushfiqur Rahman Liton and local party general secretary Krishnapada Ghosh.
Fire service personnel who reached the village around 8 pm found 20 to 30 houses on fire, the newspaper reported.
Local residents alleged that around 50 houses and shops were vandalised, looted and set ablaze by supporters of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).
